text:
Sarah (Sales): Heads-up — Ventura Insights asked to escalate. Large POC; CISO is flagging SSO + data residency + commercial terms. Need exec sync tomorrow EOD to unblock.

Raj (Solutions Eng): Thanks — what specifically is blocking the POC? We thought the test dataset could run on Dedicated in eu-west-1.

Sarah (Sales): Main blockers: 1) SSO via Okta required (SCIM + SAML). 2) Data must stay in their EU tenancy (eu-west-1). 3) They want a hard commit on monthly min tokens for pricing. Legal also wants proof of KMS audit logs. CISO needs our security questionnaire answered by Friday.

Michelle (Legal): I can take the questionnaire. Drop the vendor SQ link and any contractual asks here. Also they mentioned DPA changes — flag those items.

Sarah (Sales): Link from their side: https://ventura.example.com/vendor/sq — attached in their email. They also asked if we support customer-managed KMS + HSM for Private deployment.

Owen (Infra Eng): We support customer-managed KMS in Private. For Redwood Dedicated (cloud) we can integrate with customer KMS via cross-account CMK in eu-west-1 but ops must provision. For on-prem we can support HSM. ETA to provision a dedicated GPU pool in eu-west-1 is ~48 hours once approved.

Raj (Solutions Eng): For SSO: we have SAML + SCIM docs here: https://redwood.dev/docs/sso — I can run a quick demo with their IdP. For POC capacity, recommend starting Dedicated with autoscale off and reserved 2 x A800-equivalent nodes.

Sarah (Sales): Pricing ask: they want a blended token rate <= $0.0004/token for 6 months with commit. Can we do that?

Lisa (VP Sales): We should avoid blanket public pricing. Propose a 6-month pilot discount tied to committed monthly spend. @Michelle can legal approve a pilot agreement with limited liability + early termination? :thinking: 

Michelle (Legal): We can do a pilot MSA addendum. Need finance to confirm discount thresholds. @Tom (Finance) any guidance on minimums and discount approval limits?

Tom (Finance): If committed revenue > $50k/month we can approve up to 25% discount; discounts above that need Rev Ops/Exec sign-off. Need their expected monthly tokens to confirm.

Sarah (Sales): They estimate ~120M tokens/month during POC. At $0.0004/token that's ~$48k/month.

Tom (Finance): That's borderline. If 120M tokens/month we can likely approve ~20% discount; 25% requires Exec approval. Send formal numbers and we'll provision a spreadsheet.

Lisa (VP Sales): I'll take Exec sign-off. I'll join an exec call with their CEO and our execs. Suggest Thursday 10am PT. @Sarah can you coordinate calendar invite?

Sarah (Sales): Scheduling now. Also we still need the security questionnaire done by Friday — Michelle confirmed she'll handle it.

Raj (Solutions Eng): I'll prep a short onboarding runbook: SCIM mapping, sample SAML metadata, Dedicated cluster config, and a quick demo checklist. Will post the repo link.

Sarah (Sales): Another blocker: their infra team asked for a network diagram and firewall IP ranges for the dedicated pool. Owen — can you share the IP list?

Owen (Infra Eng): For eu-west-1 dedicated pool we'll provide egress IP ranges (examples): 34.210.45.0/24 and 52.18.33.0/24. Ops will confirm exact CIDRs and provide a PDF network diagram to attach to the security questionnaire.

Sarah (Sales): @Michelle legal also needs a clause in the DPA addendum listing subprocessors and data handling expectations.

Michelle (Legal): I'll draft the DPA addendum, include standard subprocessor list, and mark Redwood-managed logging as subprocessing with customer review rights.

deploy-bot: Deployment scheduled: create-dedicated --region eu-west-1 --size 2 --pool ventura-poc

Raj (Solutions Eng): Note: enabling KV/prefix caching on this workload should reduce token usage ~10-15% on average — worth showing two cost scenarios in the proposal.

Sarah (Sales): Good call. Can we include cost estimates with and without caching for the CFO? Need clear unit economics.

Owen (Infra Eng): I'll ask ops for a cost estimate and include KMS cross-account timing (1-2 day ops window).

Lisa (VP Sales): Action: prep an exec one-pager that lists blockers + asks (legal pilot MSA approval, commit numbers for finance, infra ETA). @Raj @Owen @Michelle please send bullet points by EOD today.

Sarah (Sales): Will compile and send the one-pager by 6pm PT.

Michelle (Legal): I'll have the first draft DPA addendum and comments by tonight.

Tom (Finance): I'll share the discount approval note and a token-to-revenue spreadsheet by EOD.

Sarah (Sales): Thanks team — appreciate the quick turnaround :pray:
